import novamind_api as nm

def q(sql):
    try:
        return nm.query(sql)['rows']
    except Exception as e:
        return [{'error': str(e)}]

print("=== CURRENT DAY ===", nm.vars.current_day)

print("\n=== TOTAL CASH ===")
print(q("SELECT SUM(amount) as cash FROM ledger"))

print("\n=== CASHFLOW BY CATEGORY (day>=358) ===")
for r in q("SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) as total, COUNT(*) as n FROM ledger WHERE day>=358 GROUP BY category ORDER BY total"):
    print(r)

print("\n=== BASE BY PLAN/GROUP (subscribed) ===")
for r in q("SELECT s.plan, c.group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY s.plan, c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC"):
    print(r)

print("\n=== SURVIVAL: renewals (sub_payment d>=358) ===")
print(q("SELECT COUNT(*) as renewals, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) as dollars FROM ledger WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day>=358"))

print("\n=== SURVIVAL: cancels (end_day>=358) ===")
print(q("SELECT COUNT(*) as cancels FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day>=358"))

print("\n=== EFF PRICE DIST (subscribed) ===")
for r in q("SELECT plan, listed_price, promotion, effective_price, COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan, listed_price, promotion, effective_price ORDER BY n DESC"):
    print(r)

print("\n=== EFF PRICE DIST (cancelled end_day>=358) ===")
for r in q("SELECT plan, listed_price, promotion, effective_price, COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day>=358 GROUP BY plan, listed_price, promotion, effective_price ORDER BY n DESC"):
    print(r)

print("\n=== BILLING WINDOWS (subscribed, mod30) ===")
for r in q("SELECT billing_day_mod30, COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY billing_day_mod30 ORDER BY billing_day_mod30"):
    print(r)

print("\n=== NEXT WK BILLING (d365-371, mod30 in 5..11) ===")
